decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  Drawing Numbers 698-P01, 698-P02, 698-P03, 698-P04, 698-P05, 698-P06, 698-P07, 698-P08, 698-P09, 698-P10A, 698-P11A, 698-P12A, 698-P13, 698-P14A, 698-P15A, 698-P16A, 698-P17A, 698-P18A, P500, P202, P203, P204, P205, P206, P208, P209, P14A, P103, P102, P100, Design and Access Statement, Tree Statement, Heritage Statement, Planning Statement, Structural Survey Report received 16/05/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted, including all bricks, tiles, coping/capping stones, roof panels/roofing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, erection of roof extension to replace existing and internal alterations to the house to include removal of non-original partitions at all floor levels and repalcement of windows at first and second floor level.  Erection of rear wall following demolition of existing and erection of external spiral access staircase to studio at rear
